name: Rocco Forte Hotel Amigo
insider_take: This elegant Brussels institution sits just steps from the Grand Place, where European royalty once mingled with merchants in one of the world's most beautiful medieval squares.
whats_special: Hotel Amigo occupies a historic building that was once a prison in the 16th century - its name "Amigo" ironically comes from the Flemish word for prison. The hotel's comic strip-themed decor pays homage to Belgium's rich comic heritage, featuring beloved characters like Tintin and The Smurfs throughout its elegant interiors.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the inner courtyard for the quietest stay, or splurge on a Grand Place view room to wake up to UNESCO World Heritage magic right outside your window.
dont_miss: The legendary Chez Léon restaurant (2-minute walk) serves the city's most famous moules-frites, and the nearby Delirium Café holds the Guinness World Record for most beer varieties available. Visit the hotel's Ristorante Bocconi for Italian cuisine in a setting adorned with original Belgian comic art.
pros: Prime location steps from Brussels' Grand Place and major attractions
Elegant blend of traditional European charm with modern luxury amenities
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Beautiful historic building with sophisticated interior design
cons: Historic building may have smaller room sizes in some categories
